dataset: Sony BKM option cards — model, function, compatible monitors
description: Every Sony BKM option card documented for the CRT-era BVM-D, BVM-E/F/G, BVM-A, PVM-L5 and PVM-L2 monitors, plus the LCD-era boards and the controllers: Sony's name for the card, what it does, which chassis it fits, and the Sony document each row rests on.

rows.function: Three serial-digital inputs with active loop-through plus three analog inputs; decodes 4:2:2 component SDI (525/625). Composite on its analog BNCs is decoded only if a decoder card (21D, 24N, 25P, 26M or 27T) sits in another slot.
rows.fits: BVM-E, F and G; BVM-D20F1, D24E1W, D32E1W
rows.sources: Sony, BKM-20D/21D/22X/24N/25P/26M/27T/28X Installation Manual (BVM D, E, F and G series); Sony, BVM-D Series brochure

rows.function: Same input set; decodes 4:2:2 component SDI, 4fsc composite SDI (NTSC and PAL) and analog composite NTSC/PAL. Needs monitor software 1.40 or later in an E-series chassis, 1.10 in a G-series, 1.20 in a D32E1W.
rows.sources: Sony, BKM-20D/21D/22X/24N/25P/26M/27T/28X Installation Manual (BVM D, E, F and G series); Sony, BVM-D Series brochure

rows.function: Three SDI inputs with active loop-through plus three analog inputs; no decoder of its own, so it needs a 20D or 21D in another slot. Only one 22X per decoder card.
rows.sources: Sony, BKM-20D/21D/22X/24N/25P/26M/27T/28X Installation Manual (BVM D, E, F and G series); Sony, BVM-D Series brochure

rows.function: Six analog BNCs, high-impedance with loop-through; decodes composite NTSC and Y/C (S-Video) NTSC.
rows.sources: Sony, BKM-20D/21D/22X/24N/25P/26M/27T/28X Installation Manual (BVM D, E, F and G series); Sony, BVM-D Series brochure

rows.function: Same hardware; composite PAL and Y/C PAL.
rows.sources: Sony, BKM-20D/21D/22X/24N/25P/26M/27T/28X Installation Manual (BVM D, E, F and G series); Sony, BVM-D Series brochure

rows.function: Same hardware; composite PAL-M and Y/C PAL-M (the Brazilian standard).
rows.sources: Sony, BKM-20D/21D/22X/24N/25P/26M/27T/28X Installation Manual (BVM D, E, F and G series); Sony, BVM-D Series brochure

rows.function: Same hardware; composite NTSC, PAL and SECAM plus Y/C.
rows.sources: Sony, BKM-20D/21D/22X/24N/25P/26M/27T/28X Installation Manual (BVM D, E, F and G series); Sony, BVM-D Series brochure

rows.function: Six analog BNCs with loop-through; adds inputs only, no decoder.
rows.sources: Sony, BKM-20D/21D/22X/24N/25P/26M/27T/28X Installation Manual (BVM D, E, F and G series); Sony, BVM-D Series brochure

rows.function: One HD serial-digital input.
rows.fits: BVM-D32E1W, D24E1W, D20F1 per Sony; an E/F fit is not documented
rows.sources: Sony, BVM-D Series brochure

rows.function: Two HD serial-digital inputs.
rows.fits: BVM-D32E1W, D24E1W, D20F1 per Sony; an E/F fit is not documented
rows.sources: Sony, BVM-D Series brochure

rows.function: Six analog inputs for HD analog signals.
rows.fits: BVM-D32E1W, D24E1W, D20F1 per Sony; ConsoleMods lists it for the 20E1U without a source
rows.sources: Sony, BVM-D Series brochure; ConsoleMods wiki, BVM-20E1U

rows.sony_name: SDI 4:2:2 Decoder Adaptor (L5 brochure); SDI 4:2:2 Input Adaptor (D and L2 brochures)
rows.function: Two D-1 serial-digital inputs with two active loop-through outputs; embedded audio not supported.
rows.sources: Sony, BVM-D Series brochure; Sony, PVM-20L5 / PVM-14L5 brochure; Sony, PVM-L2 Series brochure (2003)

rows.function: Two analog composite BNCs with loop-through and automatic 75 Ω termination, a Y/C input, and a digital three-line comb filter.
rows.fits: BVM-D14/D9 per Sony; not listed in the L5 or L2 brochures
rows.sources: Sony, BVM-D Series brochure

rows.function: One analog component input (Y/R-Y/B-Y or RGB) with loop-through, plus external-sync loop-through. The card most collectors want: it is the RGB input for a 20L5.
rows.fits: BVM-D14/D9 (supplied as standard); PVM-20L5/14L5; PVM-20L2/14L2/9L2 (the 9L2 needs it for any component input)
rows.sources: Sony, BVM-D Series brochure; Sony, PVM-20L5 / PVM-14L5 brochure; Sony, PVM-L2 Series brochure (2003)

rows.function: Two HD-SDI inputs and one monitor output; 1080/24PsF, 1080/50i, 1035/60i, 1080/60i, 720/60p. HD only — it does not scale SD.
rows.sources: Sony, BVM-D Series brochure; Sony, PVM-20L5 / PVM-14L5 brochure; shmups.system11.org, “PVM Addon Cards, are they universal?” (2023)

rows.sony_name: SDTI-CP/SDI Input Adaptor (L2); SDI with Audio Decoder Adaptor (L5)
rows.function: Two SDTI-CP/SD-SDI inputs with two loop-through outputs; MPEG-2 4:2:2P@ML decode; two analog audio outputs.
rows.sources: Sony, PVM-20L5 / PVM-14L5 brochure; Sony, PVM-L2 Series brochure (2003)

rows.sony_name: DV Input Adaptor (L2); IEEE 1394 i.LINK Input Adaptor (L5)
rows.function: Two six-pin DV connectors in and out; two analog audio outputs.
rows.sources: Sony, PVM-20L5 / PVM-14L5 brochure; Sony, PVM-L2 Series brochure (2003)

rows.function: Two analog composite PAL-M inputs with two loop-through outputs; Brazilian market.
rows.fits: PVM-L2 per Sony; an L5 or D fit is not documented
rows.sources: Sony, PVM-L2 Series brochure (2003)

rows.function: SD-SDI plus analog composite, Y/C (NTSC, PAL, PAL-M), analog component (Y/R-Y/B-Y or GBR) and SD digital component/composite (D1/D2).
rows.sources: Sony, BVM-A Series brochure (SONY51450); Sony Electronics bulletins 05-0584 and 05-0585, November 15, 2005

rows.function: HD-SDI and SD-SDI, auto-detected; dual-link 4:4:4 (SMPTE 372M) in GBR or Y/PB/PR.
rows.sources: Sony, BVM-A Series brochure (SONY51450); Sony Electronics bulletins 05-0584 and 05-0585, November 15, 2005

rows.function: Analog component, SD and HD, as Y/PB/PR or GBR; one input and one loop-through output. The console-RGB card for a BVM-A; a modern clone of it exists and is what the A14F5U here runs.
rows.sources: Sony, BVM-A Series brochure (SONY51450); Sony Electronics bulletins 05-0584 and 05-0585, November 15, 2005; ConsoleMods wiki, BKM-68X and BKM-10R

rows.function: Two SD-SDI BNCs.
rows.sources: Sony, Professional Monitor Line-up — Optional Accessories

rows.function: One composite BNC and one Y/C mini-DIN.
rows.sources: Sony, Professional Monitor Line-up — Optional Accessories

rows.function: Three RGB/component BNCs plus one external-sync BNC.
rows.sources: Sony, Professional Monitor Line-up — Optional Accessories

rows.function: Two HD/SD-SDI BNCs. Does not fit a CRT PVM.
rows.fits: LMD-51 series; the later OLED and LCD BVMs and LMDs
rows.sources: Sony, Professional Monitor Line-up — Optional Accessories; Sony Professional, BKM-243HS product page; shmups.system11.org, “PVM Addon Cards, are they universal?” (2023)

rows.function: Two HD/SD-SDI BNCs with EIA-708 caption decoding.
rows.sources: Sony, Professional Monitor Line-up — Optional Accessories

rows.function: 3G-SDI, single-link 4:4:4 RGB, 1080/60p, with loop-through.
rows.fits: LMD-51 series per Sony; dealers list it for BVM-L and PVM-L
rows.sources: Sony, Professional Monitor Line-up — Optional Accessories; Expandore (Sony dealer), LMD accessories

rows.function: One HD/SD-SDI BNC.
rows.fits: LMD-30 and LMD-10 series per Sony
rows.sources: Sony, Professional Monitor Line-up — Optional Accessories

rows.function: Rack-width remote; RS-422 over a DE-9 cable, powered by the monitor; controls one monitor or a daisy chain. The one on the BVM-20E1U here.
rows.sources: ConsoleMods wiki, BVM-20E1U; ConsoleMods wiki, BKM-68X and BKM-10R; crtdatabase.com, Sony BKM controllers

rows.function: The small handheld controller that plugs into the monitor's front.
rows.sources: ConsoleMods wiki, BVM-20E1U; crtdatabase.com, Sony BKM controllers

rows.function: The BVM-A generation's controller.
rows.sources: Sony Electronics bulletins 05-0584 and 05-0585, November 15, 2005

rows.function: Screen-mounted probe for the BVM-A's automatic white-balance and alignment routine.
rows.sources: Sony Electronics bulletins 05-0584 and 05-0585, November 15, 2005

rows.function: Mount a control unit to the monitor.
rows.sources: Sony Electronics bulletins 05-0584 and 05-0585, November 15, 2005

rows.function: Rack rails for the 14-inch and 20-inch BVM-A.
rows.sources: Sony Electronics bulletins 05-0584 and 05-0585, November 15, 2005
